verses.en: And unto the angel of the church in Sardis write; These things saith he that hath the seven Spirits of God, and the seven stars; I know thy works, that thou hast a name that thou livest, and art dead.
verses.pt: Ao anjo da igreja em Sardes escreve: Isto diz aquele que tem os sete espíritos de Deus, e as estrelas: Conheço as tuas obras; tens nome de que vives, e estás morto.
verses.en_web: “And to the angel of the assembly in Sardis write: “He who has the seven Spirits of God, and the seven stars says these things: “I know your works, that you have a reputation of being alive, but you are dead.
verses.en_bbe: And to the angel of the church in Sardis say: These things says he who has the seven Spirits of God and the seven stars: I have knowledge of your works, that you seem to be living but are dead.

verses.en: Be watchful, and strengthen the things which remain, that are ready to die: for I have not found thy works perfect before God.
verses.pt: Sê vigilante, e confirma o restante, que estava para morrer; porque não tenho achado as tuas obras perfeitas diante do meu Deus.
verses.en_web: Wake up, and keep the things that remain, which you were about to throw away, for I have found no works of yours perfected before my God.
verses.en_bbe: Be on the watch, and make strong the rest of the things which are near to death; because as judged by me your works have not come up to God's measure.

verses.en: Remember therefore how thou hast received and heard, and hold fast, and repent. If therefore thou shalt not watch, I will come on thee as a thief, and thou shalt not know what hour I will come upon thee.
verses.pt: Lembra-te, portanto, do que tens recebido e ouvido, e guarda-o, e arrepende-te. Pois se não vigiares, virei como um ladrão, e não saberás a que hora sobre ti virei.
verses.en_web: Remember therefore how you have received and heard. Keep it, and repent. If therefore you won’t watch, I will come as a thief, and you won’t know what hour I will come upon you.
verses.en_bbe: Keep in mind, then, the teaching which was given to you, and be ruled by it and have a change of heart. If then you do not keep watch, I will come like a thief, and you will have no knowledge of the hour when I will come on you.

verses.en: Thou hast a few names even in Sardis which have not defiled their garments; and they shall walk with me in white: for they are worthy.
verses.pt: Mas também tens em Sardes algumas pessoas que não contaminaram as suas vestes e comigo andarão vestidas de branco, porquanto são dignas.
verses.en_web: Nevertheless you have a few names in Sardis that did not defile their garments. They will walk with me in white, for they are worthy.
verses.en_bbe: But you have some names in Sardis who have kept clean their robes; and as a reward they will go in white with me.

verses.en: He that overcometh, the same shall be clothed in white raiment; and I will not blot out his name out of the book of life, but I will confess his name before my Father, and before his angels.
verses.pt: O que vencer será assim vestido de vestes brancas, e de maneira nenhuma riscarei o seu nome do livro da vida; antes confessarei o seu nome diante de meu Pai e diante dos seus anjos.
verses.en_web: He who overcomes will be arrayed in white garments, and I will in no way blot his name out of the book of life, and I will confess his name before my Father, and before his angels.
verses.en_bbe: He who overcomes will be dressed in white, and I will not take his name from the book of life, and I will give witness to his name before my Father, and before his angels.

verses.en: He that hath an ear, let him hear what the Spirit saith unto the churches.
verses.pt: Quem tem ouvidos, ouça o que o espírito diz às igrejas.
verses.en_web: He who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the assemblies.
verses.en_bbe: He who has ears, let him give ear to what the Spirit says to the churches.

verses.en: And to the angel of the church in Philadelphia write; These things saith he that is holy, he that is true, he that hath the key of David, he that openeth, and no man shutteth; and shutteth, and no man openeth;
verses.pt: Ao anjo da igreja em Filadélfia escreve: Isto diz o que é santo, o que é verdadeiro, o que tem a chave de Davi; o que abre, e ninguém fecha; e fecha, e ninguém abre:
verses.en_web: “To the angel of the assembly in Philadelphia write: “He who is holy, he who is true, he who has the key of David, he who opens and no one can shut, and who shuts and no one opens, says these things:
verses.en_bbe: And to the angel of the church in Philadelphia say: These things says he who is holy, he who is true, he who has the key of David, opening the door so that it may be shut by no one, and shutting it so that it may be open to no one.

verses.en: I know thy works: behold, I have set before thee an open door, and no man can shut it: for thou hast a little strength, and hast kept my word, and hast not denied my name.
verses.pt: Conheço as tuas obras (eis que tenho posto diante de ti uma porta aberta, que ninguém pode fechar), que tens pouca força, entretanto guardaste a minha palavra e não negaste o meu nome.
verses.en_web: “I know your works (behold, I have set before you an open door, which no one can shut), that you have a little power, and kept my word, and didn’t deny my name.
verses.en_bbe: I have knowledge of your works (see, I have put before you an open door which may be shut by no one), and that you have a little strength, and have kept my word, and have been true to my name.

verses.en: Behold, I will make them of the synagogue of Satan, which say they are Jews, and are not, but do lie; behold, I will make them to come and worship before thy feet, and to know that I have loved thee.
verses.pt: Eis que farei aos da sinagoga de Satanás, aos que se dizem judeus, e não o são, mas mentem, - eis que farei que venham, e adorem prostrados aos teus pés, e saibam que eu te amo.
verses.en_web: Behold, I give some of the synagogue of Satan, of those who say they are Jews, and they are not, but lie. Behold, I will make them to come and worship before your feet, and to know that I have loved you.
verses.en_bbe: See, I will make those of the Synagogue of Satan who say they are Jews, and are not, but say what is false; I will make them come and give worship before your feet, and see my love for you.

verses.en: Because thou hast kept the word of my patience, I also will keep thee from the hour of temptation, which shall come upon all the world, to try them that dwell upon the earth.
verses.pt: Porquanto guardaste a palavra da minha perseverança, também eu te guardarei da hora da provação que há de vir sobre o mundo inteiro, para pôr à prova os que habitam sobre a terra.
verses.en_web: Because you kept my command to endure, I also will keep you from the hour of testing, which is to come on the whole world, to test those who dwell on the earth.
verses.en_bbe: Because you have kept my word in quiet strength, I will keep you from the hour of testing which is coming on all the world, to put to the test those who are on earth.

verses.en: Behold, I come quickly: hold that fast which thou hast, that no man take thy crown.
verses.pt: Venho sem demora; guarda o que tens, para que ninguém tome a tua coroa.
verses.en_web: I am coming quickly! Hold firmly that which you have, so that no one takes your crown.
verses.en_bbe: I come quickly: keep that which you have, so that no one may take your crown.

verses.en: Him that overcometh will I make a pillar in the temple of my God, and he shall go no more out: and I will write upon him the name of my God, and the name of the city of my God, which is new Jerusalem, which cometh down out of heaven from my God: and I will write upon him my new name.
verses.pt: A quem vencer, eu o farei coluna no templo do meu Deus, donde jamais sairá; e escreverei sobre ele o nome do meu Deus, e o nome da cidade do meu Deus, a nova Jerusalém, que desce do céu, da parte do meu Deus, e também o meu novo nome.
verses.en_web: He who overcomes, I will make him a pillar in the temple of my God, and he will go out from there no more. I will write on him the name of my God, and the name of the city of my God, the new Jerusalem, which comes down out of heaven from my God, and my own new name.
verses.en_bbe: Him who overcomes I will make a pillar in the house of my God, and he will go out no more: and I will put on him the name of my God, and the name of the town of my God, the new Jerusalem, which comes down out of heaven from my God, and my new name.

verses.en: He that hath an ear, let him hear what the Spirit saith unto the churches.
verses.pt: Quem tem ouvidos, ouça o que o Espírito diz às igrejas.
verses.en_web: He who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the assemblies.
verses.en_bbe: He who has ears, let him give ear to what the Spirit says to the churches.

verses.en: And unto the angel of the church of the Laodiceans write; These things saith the Amen, the faithful and true witness, the beginning of the creation of God;
verses.pt: Ao anjo da igreja em Laodicéia escreve: Isto diz o Amém, a testemunha fiel e verdadeira, o pricípio da criação de Deus:
verses.en_web: “To the angel of the assembly in Laodicea write: “The Amen, the Faithful and True Witness, the Beginning of God’s creation, says these things:
verses.en_bbe: And to the angel of the church in Laodicea say: These things says the true and certain witness, the head of God's new order:

verses.en: I know thy works, that thou art neither cold nor hot: I would thou wert cold or hot.
verses.pt: Conheço as tuas obras, que nem és frio nem quente; oxalá foras frio ou quente!
verses.en_web: “I know your works, that you are neither cold nor hot. I wish you were cold or hot.
verses.en_bbe: I have knowledge of your works, that you are not cold or warm: it would be better if you were cold or warm.

verses.en: So then because thou art lukewarm, and neither cold nor hot, I will spue thee out of my mouth.
verses.pt: Assim, porque és morno, e não és quente nem frio, vomitar-te-ei da minha boca.
verses.en_web: So, because you are lukewarm, and neither hot nor cold, I will vomit you out of my mouth.
verses.en_bbe: So because you are not one thing or the other, I will have no more to do with you.

verses.en: Because thou sayest, I am rich, and increased with goods, and have need of nothing; and knowest not that thou art wretched, and miserable, and poor, and blind, and naked:
verses.pt: Porquanto dizes: Rico sou, e estou enriquecido, e de nada tenho falta; e não sabes que és um coitado, e miserável, e pobre, e cego, e nu;
verses.en_web: Because you say, ‘I am rich, and have gotten riches, and have need of nothing;’ and don’t know that you are the wretched one, miserable, poor, blind, and naked;
verses.en_bbe: For you say, I have wealth, and have got together goods and land, and have need of nothing; and you are not conscious of your sad and unhappy condition, that you are poor and blind and without clothing.

verses.en: I counsel thee to buy of me gold tried in the fire, that thou mayest be rich; and white raiment, that thou mayest be clothed, and that the shame of thy nakedness do not appear; and anoint thine eyes with eyesalve, that thou mayest see.
verses.pt: aconselho-te que de mim compres ouro refinado no fogo, para que te enriqueças; e vestes brancas, para que te vistas, e não seja manifesta a vergonha da tua nudez; e colírio, a fim de ungires os teus olhos, para que vejas.
verses.en_web: I counsel you to buy from me gold refined by fire, that you may become rich; and white garments, that you may clothe yourself, and that the shame of your nakedness may not be revealed; and eye salve to anoint your eyes, that you may see.
verses.en_bbe: If you are wise you will get from me gold tested by fire, so that you may have true wealth; and white robes to put on, so that your shame may not be seen; and oil for your eyes, so that you may see.

verses.en: As many as I love, I rebuke and chasten: be zealous therefore, and repent.
verses.pt: Eu repreendo e castigo a todos quantos amo: sê pois zeloso, e arrepende-te.
verses.en_web: As many as I love, I reprove and chasten. Be zealous therefore, and repent.
verses.en_bbe: To all those who are dear to me, I give sharp words and punishment: then with all your heart have sorrow for your evil ways.

verses.en: Behold, I stand at the door, and knock: if any man hear my voice, and open the door, I will come in to him, and will sup with him, and he with me.
verses.pt: Eis que estou à porta e bato; se alguém ouvir a minha voz, e abrir a porta, entrarei em sua casa, e com ele cearei, e ele comigo.
verses.en_web: Behold, I stand at the door and knock. If anyone hears my voice and opens the door, then I will come in to him, and will dine with him, and he with me.
verses.en_bbe: See, I am waiting at the door and giving the sign; if my voice comes to any man's ears and he makes the door open, I will come in to him, and will take food with him and he with me.

verses.en: To him that overcometh will I grant to sit with me in my throne, even as I also overcame, and am set down with my Father in his throne.
verses.pt: Ao que vencer, eu lhe concederei que se assente comigo no meu trono.
verses.en_web: He who overcomes, I will give to him to sit down with me on my throne, as I also overcame, and sat down with my Father on his throne.
verses.en_bbe: To him who overcomes I will give a place with me on my high seat, even as I overcame, and am seated with my Father on his high seat.

verses.en: He that hath an ear, let him hear what the Spirit saith unto the churches.
verses.pt: Quem tem ouvidos, ouça o que o Espírito diz às igrejas.
verses.en_web: He who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the assemblies.”
verses.en_bbe: He who has ears, let him give ear to what the Spirit says to the churches.
